en: The image is a sepia-toned postcard displaying a large, ornate timber-framed building with a sign reading 'Gasth. Lenglerhaus Restaurant.' The building sits on a grassy hill with trees nearby and a forest in the background. The layout and design suggest an early 20th-century European mountain lodge. There is red printed text in German in the top right and along the left edge of the postcard.
